A garden in full bloom, captured in silk. A vivid botanical print and softly rolled edge bring a painterly note of colour to the everyday, whether knotted at the neck or worn in the hair.

The story +

Inspired by the flower stalls along the Seine, the hand-drawn botanical motif brings together sunlit petals and expressive colour.

Details & care +

100% silk twill, printed and hand-rolled in France. Dry clean only. Presented in a reusable cotton gift envelope.

Delivery & returns +

Complimentary standard delivery on orders over €150. Returns are accepted within 30 days when items are unworn and in their original packaging.
